Name: The Bell Ringer
Title: Lieutenant of the Overflow
IntroLine: The bell tolls for YOU, temps!
ContractText: Contract #4471: A bell ringer who swore he would ring until the end of time. He meant it. Signed: the Merchant of Hours.

Name: The Gravekeeper
Title: Keeper of Unquiet Earth
IntroLine: These graves are MINE. Every one of them.
ContractText: Contract #5012: A gravedigger who buried a thousand souls and decided he would never be buried himself. Signed: the Merchant of Hours.

Name: The Sexton
Title: Warden of the First Graveyard
IntroLine: I dug the first grave. I will not lie in it.
ContractText: Contract #0412: The sexton who dug the world's first grave traded it for eternity. The Merchant's ink smells of seawater...

Name: The Drowned King
Title: Lord of the Sunken Harbour
IntroLine: The tide answers to me, little reapers.
ContractText: Contract #0001: Signed in seawater. The very first contract the Merchant of Hours ever sold. The next page mentions a carnival.

Name: The Ringmaster
Title: Showman of the Plague Carnival
IntroLine: Ladies, gentlemen and the freshly dead - welcome!
ContractText: Contract #0777: The Ringmaster sold tickets to eternity and kept the change. A monastery's seal is pressed into the wax.

Name: The Abbot Who Would Not Kneel
Title: Saint of the Frozen Monastery
IntroLine: I prayed for more years. Someone answered.
ContractText: Contract #0003: The Abbot's prayers were answered by the Merchant himself. The address on the back: the Clocktower.

Name: The Merchant of Hours
Title: Seller of Eternity
IntroLine: Every soul has a price, reaper. What's yours?
ContractText: The Merchant's ledger, burned. Every contract is void. For the first time in ten thousand years, Death gets a quiet night.
